$Comment: The Grave Candle again, priced in Life Essence alone: a second way to pay for the Headless Horseman's graveyard for a player with essence to spare and no Sweets, set high so the Sweets offer stays the usual way. Life Essence is an item-backed wallet this pack ships (Currencies/MMOSkillTree/Life_Essence.json), taken as Ingredient_Life_Essence from the bag, so the offer works on every server. Requires is the Sweets offer's own lock: it opens once Old Jack counts the player a Regular (Friendly with Old Jack's Favor), and a locked offer still shows on the shelf with its lock line; keep the two offers' locks the same. SortOrder 6 sits it straight after the Sweets offer (Hallows_Eve_Offer_Grave_Candle.json, SortOrder 5) on the lanterns shelf. No purchase limit and no rotation, like the Sweets offer. Cost is the price in Life Essence. Named by the item's own keys.
